report.tagline: Spinny buys used cars, fixes them up and sells them with a warranty and a money-back promise.
report.simpleSummary: Buying a second-hand car in India is scary because you do not know if the seller is hiding problems. Spinny buys cars itself, checks and repairs them, and then sells them at a fixed price, like a shop. You can test drive at home, get a loan and insurance in the app, and return the car within a few days if you do not like it. It also buys your old car on the spot.

overview.whatItDoes: Spinny is a full-stack used-car shop: it owns its stock and does every step itself. It buys cars from people, repairs them in its own workshops, and sells them online and in large car hubs at a fixed price. It adds loans, insurance, warranty and, since buying GoMechanic in late 2025, car servicing.
howItWorks: Sellers book an inspection. Spinny checks the car, gives a price, and pays the same day if the seller agrees.
The car goes to a Spinny reconditioning centre, where it is checked, repaired, cleaned and photographed.
Buyers browse cars on the app with 360-degree photos, an inspection report and a fixed price. No bargaining.
Buyers book a test drive at home or at a Spinny hub, then pay, often with a loan from Spinny's partners or Spinny Capital.
Every Spinny Assured car comes with a short money-back window and a warranty.
Cars Spinny does not want to retail go to dealers through its auction platform.
overview.valueProposition: Buy a used car with the trust of buying a new one: checked, fixed, fixed price, warranty, and a way out if it goes wrong.

painPoints.pain: Not knowing if a used car was in an accident or has a tampered odometer.
painPoints.howSolved: Detailed inspection report on every car and Spinny takes responsibility as the seller.

painPoints.pain: Bargaining with dealers and feeling cheated.
painPoints.howSolved: Fixed, listed prices with no haggling.

painPoints.pain: Getting stuck with a bad car.
painPoints.howSolved: Money-back window after delivery and a warranty.

painPoints.pain: Getting a loan for a used car.
painPoints.howSolved: Loans arranged in the app through partner banks and Spinny Capital.

painPoints.pain: Selling an old car takes weeks and many calls.
painPoints.howSolved: Inspection, offer and payment in one visit.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: A long checklist inspection of each car before it is listed.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Trust is the main thing buyers lack in used cars.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Return the car within a few days of delivery for a refund.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Removes the fear of a wrong choice and lifts conversion.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: One clear price for each car.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Saves buyers from haggling and lets Spinny control margin.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Spinny brings the car to you to drive.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Makes buying easy for busy people and gets them closer to a decision.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Finance and insurance in the same checkout.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Most buyers need a loan, and Spinny earns a fee on each.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: After-sales repair and servicing through the GoMechanic network.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Keeps owners in touch with Spinny and brings future sellers.

steps.detail: Filters by budget, body type and city on the app.
Looks at photos, inspection report and price.
Sees monthly EMI and gets a pre-approval.
Books a home test drive or visits a hub.
Pays a token amount, then the rest or a loan down payment.
Car is delivered with paperwork in process.
Drives for a few days and decides to keep it.
Adds model, year and kilometres and gets a price range.
An inspector comes home or the seller visits a hub.
Gets a firm price after inspection.
Money comes to the bank, loan closure handled if needed.
Waits for the ownership papers to come in their name.
Raises a claim if a covered part fails.
Comes back to Spinny to sell after a few years.

businessModel.summary: Spinny makes money from the gap between what it pays for a car and what it sells it for, plus fees from loans, insurance, warranties and now servicing. About 98% of revenue is car sales.

revenueStreams.detail: Buys low, refurbishes, sells at a fixed price. Main revenue line.
Commission from partner lenders and insurers, and interest from Spinny Capital loans.
Extra paid plans on top of the car.
Cars that do not fit retail are sold to dealers.
Repair and service revenue, about ₹145 crore in FY25 before the deal.

businessModel.pricing: Each car has a fixed listed price on the site. Most popular cars are in the ₹3 lakh to ₹10 lakh range. Extended warranty and protection plans cost extra.
costDrivers: Buying cars (inventory), which is most of the cost
Holding cost of unsold cars: money stuck and price falling every month
Marketing, including cricket and TV ads
businessModel.unitEconomics: Think of a car Spinny sells for ₹5 lakh. It may have paid about ₹4.4 lakh for it and spent ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 fixing it. That leaves roughly ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 gross margin per car, about 4% to 6% (Inc42's numbers suggest about ₹209 crore gross margin on ₹4,650 crore sales in FY25). Loan and insurance fees add a few thousand rupees more. Out of that it must pay for hubs, staff and ads. Every extra week a car sits unsold eats into this small margin, so selling fast is everything.

howTheyGetUsers: TV and cricket sponsorships for brand trust
Sellers who become buyers on the same visit
Media brands like Autocar India for car buyers in research mode
whatBringsUsersBack: Servicing through GoMechanic every few months
Selling the same car back to Spinny later
growth.moat: Trust built through years of inspections, repairs and refunds is slow to copy. Spinny also has pricing data on lakhs of cars, which helps it buy at the right price, and large reconditioning centres that small dealers cannot afford.

competitors.name: Cars24
competitors.positioning: Large used-car platform that started with buying cars from sellers and selling to dealers, now also sells to consumers.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Spinny has stayed focused on retail to consumers with its own refurbishment, while Cars24 has a bigger dealer and seller-side business.

competitors.name: CarDekho / CarTrade (OLX Autos)
competitors.positioning: Listings marketplaces that connect buyers and sellers.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: They do not own most of the cars, so they carry less risk but give fewer guarantees.

competitors.name: Maruti True Value and Mahindra First Choice
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Strong brand trust for one make, but Spinny offers all brands online.

competitors.name: Local dealers and OLX
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Spinny charges more for trust, inspection and return policy.

northStar.metric: Cars delivered and kept past the money-back window each month
northStar.why: A car that is kept means the buyer trusted it and was happy. Sales that get returned look good on day one but show broken trust.

guardrailMetrics: Days a car sits in inventory
strengths: Clear trust promise: inspection, fixed price, warranty and money-back
Owns the full chain from buying to servicing
Large scale with about 13,000 cars a month
Strong investors and a 2027 IPO plan
weaknesses: Thin margin on each car, about 4% to 6% gross
Needs a lot of cash to hold cars
Still loss-making at about ₹424 crore in FY25
Paperwork and service quality complaints in some cities
risks: Used-car prices can fall fast, leaving Spinny with cars worth less than it paid
EVs and new fuel rules like E20 could change which used cars hold value
Cars24 and car-maker programmes compete hard
New-car discounts make used cars less attractive
userComplaints: Delays in RC transfer after buying
Defects found after delivery that the inspection missed
Sellers say final offers drop a lot after inspection
Refunds in the money-back window take time

improvementIdeas.idea: RC transfer tracker with a fixed deadline and payout if late
improvementIdeas.problem: Paperwork delay is a top complaint.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: More trust and fewer support calls.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Average RC transfer days and related tickets

improvementIdeas.idea: Show the inspection photo of every flagged issue in the listing
Price-lock band for sellers before inspection
improvementIdeas.problem: Sellers feel the offer drops unfairly.

improvementIdeas.idea: Free first GoMechanic service with every car
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: More service revenue and future resale leads.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Share of buyers who service within 6 months

improvementIdeas.idea: Dynamic price drops for cars older than 30 days in stock
improvementIdeas.problem: Old stock loses value and ties up cash.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Faster sales and lower holding cost.

pmLessons: In a trust-poor market, guarantees like money-back are the product, not just a policy.
Owning inventory gives control over quality but makes speed of sale the most important number.
Small margins mean add-ons like loans, insurance and servicing decide profit.
Buying a services company (GoMechanic) can turn a one-time sale into a long relationship.

interviewQuestions.question: Spinny's return rate in the money-back window doubled last month. What do you do?
interviewQuestions.hint: Check by city, car type, inspector and hub. Look at reasons for return. Fix the listing or the inspection.

interviewQuestions.question: Should Spinny move to a marketplace model like CarDekho?
interviewQuestions.hint: Compare risk, margin, trust and control. Suggest a hybrid for older or cheaper cars.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you cut the time a car sits in inventory?
interviewQuestions.hint: Better buying data, faster repair, dynamic pricing, push to buyers who searched for that model.

interviewQuestions.question: Design a feature to increase repeat business from past buyers.
interviewQuestions.hint: Service reminders, warranty renewal, trade-in offers timed to car age.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you measure the success of the GoMechanic acquisition?
interviewQuestions.hint: Share of Spinny buyers who service, new users from servicing who later buy or sell, service margin.
